title: Supplementary Notice on Binance Futures COIN-M System Upgrade (2026-06-30)
text: This is a general Binance Exchange Notice. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. Fellow Binancians, Besides the affected services listed  here  during Binance Futures COIN-M system upgrade period, please note that the following services will also be affected： About COIN-M Futures: Starting from  2026-06-30 , leverage levels over 5x are not available to COIN-M Futures Accounts created by regular users’ sub-accounts.  If the leverage levels of the regular users’ sub-accounts are over 5x, Binance Futures will adjust the leverage levels to 5x during the upgrade period. The adjustment will not affect the existing positions opened before the upgrade. Futures running grid might  expire  due to the leverage adjustment, users are advised to adjust accordingly prior to the start of upgrade. About API Keys Creation: API users are not able to  create new API keys  and  to edit API keys for any permissions  from  2026-06-30 01:00 (UTC) to 2026-06-30 07:00 (UTC).   For more information, please refer to: Notice on Binance Futures COIN-M System Upgrade (2026-06-30) Note:  There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions. Please refer to the original English version for the most accurate information, in case any discrepancies arise. Thank you for your support! Binance Team 2026-06-29
